prompt.en: Write the Book I line. What is the flame made of, what is the seed made of, and is there a difference?

text.en: Flame and seed are made of the same few atoms. Carbon, hydrogen and oxygen make up most of both. The seed adds nitrogen, phosphorus, sulphur and a pinch of metals. The boiled seed has exactly the same list as the live one. There is no difference in what they are made of.
